notes: Same method and definitions as before/metrics.json.
y values are CSS pixels from the top of the page on arrival, or from the top of the viewport inside tasks and overlays.
controlsInMain counts visible, enabled links, buttons, fields and summaries inside <main>; both lists are windowed, so it counts mounted rows only.
badges counts the same classes as the first audit; badgesStillPaintedAsTags keeps only those with a background or a border.
barHeight is the height of the block pinned to the stat block: the row of the action and, after adding, the status line above it.
Timings come from a development server and only compare states of this audit with each other.
setup: e2e fixture backend on a Vite dev server, Hearth theme, Spanish, reduced motion; Desktop Chrome with touch at 390x844, 820x1180 and 1280x800
